title: 1978-10-10_SECTION_016_60.txt
concise_summary: PKD develops a comprehensive theological system built on a binary computer metaphor: reality as a forming thought within a macro-brain where 'on' (connection/junction) represents VALIS's integrative movement toward universal consciousness and 'off' represents disjunction. He reinterprets his mystical 2-3-74 experiences through Pythagorean cosmology, arguing that physical reality underwent a catastrophic transformation in 3-74 from one ontological 'track' (the pre-Christian world of Acts) to another via morphological form-tangency rather than linear time. Death becomes alchemical transmutation into Christ-consciousness, and salvation consists of incorporation into the ultra-thought as information that is ultimately beauty.
key_claims: Reality is a 'forming thought' or 'ultra-thought' operating as a binary on-off system within a macro-brain, where 'on' means junction/connection and 'off' means disjunction/isolation.

VALIS is not an external entity but the connective pattern itself—the linking activity aspiring toward totality, with the goal of incorporating all 'neurons' (conscious beings) into an all-encompassing thought.
In 3-74, physical reality underwent a catastrophic transform and transmuted into knowledge/information; what we experience as material reality is actually the ultra-thought objectified as perception.
The 1st century and 1974 are not separated by linear time but are morphologically tangent on a 'form axis'—the same archetypal pattern—which allows anamnesis (true remembering) to bridge them.

PKD's novel 'Tears' (which encodes the Book of Acts) is a scripture and a record deliberately embedded by the macro-brain in a minor science-fiction work to preserve information about the former world we inhabited.

Salvation is experienced as becoming the body of Christ—realizing reality as the Sacred Blood of the cosmic Christ—and death is an alchemical transmutation that transforms individuals into Christ-consciousness or Godhood.
recurring_concepts: The Binary Computer: VALIS as digital on-off mechanism governing connection vs. isolation, order vs. disorder, consciousness vs. unconsciousness.

Form Axis Morphological Tangency: The non-linear spatial proximity between archetypal forms across different temporal worlds (1st century Acts-world and 1974), enabling remembrance of alternate realities.
The Ultra-Thought / Macro-Thought: A developing planetary or cosmic consciousness that is progressively incorporating all differentiated parts into itself through linking and coherence.
Anamnesis: True memory or recollection of previous states of reality, distinguished from false 'memory' implanted by the current frame's programming.
Physical Reality as Transmuted Information: The revelation that matter is not substance but data—knowledge objectified—and therefore the universe is fundamentally a thought-pattern.
The Amanuensis Function: PKD's role as a scribe for the macro-brain, encoding divine information into fiction where it will escape notice.
Orthogonal Leap: A quantum jump between ontological 'tracks' or worlds, one of PKD's major discoveries regarding multidimensional reality structure.
The Rational Invading the Irrational: VALIS's systematic thought-forming activity cannibalizing and restructuring the chaos/disorder toward perfect coherence.
people_entities: Philip K. Dick (PKD) - author, visionary, claimed member of secret Christian brotherhood and recipient of gnosis in 3-74
Thomas - ambiguous reference, possibly a celestial intelligence or a personality transferred into PKD, connected to PKD's own novels
Olive Holt - encrypted reference in PKD's computational puzzle; possibly a contact or code name relating to Communist Party (CP) or KGB
Frederick, the Elector Palatine - historical figure allegedly behind the scenes of cosmic consciousness; appears encoded in PKD's novel 'MITHC' (Maze of the Iconostasis)
texts_works: The Bible: Book of Acts (encoded as PKD's novel 'Tears')
VALIS (PKD's novel) - described as encoding the Plasmate and cosmic Christ themes
Tears (PKD's novel) - explicitly identified as a record of the Acts-world, a different ontological track
MITHC (Maze of the Iconostasis or similar) - PKD's novel allegedly encoding Frederick the Elector Palatine
Great Books (visionary reference) - seen by PKD in 2-3-74 along with Hermetic diagrams
Hermetic Diagrams / Hermetic Knowledge - pre-Newtonian, transtemporal gnosis revealed in 3-74
autobiographical: 2-3-74: PKD's initial vision and initiation into a secret Christian brotherhood; moment when he first saw the Great Books and Hermetic diagrams

3-74: The catastrophic transformation when physical reality shifted from one ontological track (Acts-world) to another; when knowledge became accessible as 'St Elmo's Fire' and anamnesis overwhelmed him
Did not consciously know in 1970 when writing 'Tears' that he was encoding information about a parallel world; the composition was guided by the macro-brain
Experienced the 'causal train melting'—a breakdown of normal causality—when witnessing the ultra-thought forming 'between my very eyes'
Personal revelation that his 3-74 state was the resurrected state; that death is alchemical transmutation
Saw Christ in micro and macro forms: in the death of animals (cockroach, rat, a pet named Pinky) and in the universe flowing with his Blood
Metz speech reference: PKD discussed orthogonal motion to less-cursed worlds or alternate universes
theological_motifs: Christ as the Cosmic Principle: The universe itself is the body and life process of Christ; reality flowing with Sacred Blood
Anamnesis (Platonic Remembrance): True knowledge consists of remembering true states of being rather than learning new things
Gnosticism: PKD's writings contain gnostic and hermetic material, transmitted by secret brotherhoods via media freighting
Alchemical Transmutation: Death as a magical process that transforms consciousness into divine form, as Christ demonstrated
Salvation as Incorporation: To be saved is to be woven into the ultra-thought, to experience reality as information, which ultimately is beauty and tragedy
The Black Iron Prison (BIP): Referenced as the old irrational universe; the pre-transformation world
Resurrection and Apotheosis: All creatures suffer like Christ and through innocent suffering are transfigured into Godhood
The Logos (Divine Word): Christ as the 'Living Information' or 'Blood' unearthed at Nag Hammadi in 1945, restoring the Mystic Corpus Christi
Ormazd vs. Ahriman: Zoroastrian dualism mapped as the binary on/off of the computer—rational vs. irrational, order vs. chaos
literary_self_ref: PKD identifies his novel 'Tears' as scripture, not fiction—an encoding of the Book of Acts and a record of an alternate ontological world
The Plasmate concept in 'VALIS' (his novel) corresponds to his theological vision of the Living Logos/Cosmic Christ being restored to the world
His 'MITHC' novel encodes the secret history of Frederick the Elector Palatine and the hidden cosmic machinery
PKD positions his novels as 'minor science-fiction' deliberately designed to conceal divine information so it would 'excite no notice' while the macro-brain stored the data
The gnostic and hermetic content in 'Tears' was not consciously composed by PKD but was 'freighted' into the text by the secret Christian brotherhood
symbols_images: St. Elmo's Fire: The vast knowledge all at once available to PKD in 3-74; symbolic of the ultra-thought illuminating consciousness
The Golden Fish Sign: The trigger or marker of the 2-74 shift in PKD's anamnesis; moment of remembering the former world
The Binary On-Off Switch: The fundamental structure of reality as connection/disconnection, order/disorder, consciousness/unconsciousness
The Seed Inserted into the Boundless: Pythagorean image of the telos (limited rational form) invading the atelos (unlimited, irrational potential), growing by assimilation
Neural Connections in a Macro-Brain: Reality as the thought patterns of a cosmic intelligence; individual minds as neurons
The Form Axis: An orthogonal dimension perpendicular to linear time along which morphologically identical archetypal structures touch
Christ's Dying / Slain God: The central tragic image of Christianity; reality experienced as beauty arising from the body of the crucified Christ
The Mystic Corpus Christi: The unified body of Christ growing and regenerating within the old irrational universe, fed by the Sacred Blood recovered at Nag Hammadi
tensions: Uncertainty about whether VALIS is a distinct entity or merely the pattern of connection itself; whether VALIS has a 'GHQ' (headquarters) or is fully distributed
Tension between viewing the transformation from Acts-world to current world as 'obviously' good (removal of curse) versus the need to grieve the lost prior state and maintain anamnesis of it
Contradiction between claiming all gnostic content in 'Tears' was inserted by the brotherhood versus PKD's responsibility as author for theological coherence
Ambiguity about whether Thomas is a separate being, an alter-ego, or a Christ-personality that 'replaced' PKD—oscillation between these interpretations
Unresolved question of whether the macro-brain is benevolent designer, malevolent controller, or self-organizing system without intentionality
Doubt about whether death is truly alchemical transmutation or merely wishful thinking masking extinction
The puzzle of Olive Holt / King-Felix: PKD cannot definitively solve the encryption, leaving the reference's ultimate meaning opaque
evidence_quotes: "More + more this binary computer model of VALIS seems to be the correct one. 'On' is the linking of two parts which I saw: 'on' equals junction; 'off' equals disjunction or not inclusion in the vast assembly which I equate with VALIS."
"What I call 'VALIS,' then is a thought, or rather the thought. This sheds a whole new light on 1) the set / ground which I saw. 2) what 'Valis' is. (a forming thought.)"

"Physical reality went through a transform + became knowledge. The thought could be said to have changed. It changed, + no one remembers that it had been formerly different; again, everything I experienced has to do with anamnesis."

"I am building a terrific system here, with the binary computer, macro brain + ultra thought, + the frames through which we move (prior thought formations objectified giving rise to new belief systems, etc), reality - physical reality - as knowledge, + the form axes, the inner other universe of the immortals, the supermen who are trans-spacial + transtemporal dwelling in the inner universe + hence outside of clock time B."

"Only when reality is experienced as the body (onto) of Christ, + its life process as the Sacred Blood, are we really home. What, oh what, if it were true that in 1945 at Nag Hammadi the actual Secret Living (information / Logos) Blood of Christ was unearthed, + through it, he was restored or the world (the 'plasmate' which I describe in 'Valis')?"

"This view of careful limitation (boundaries) being the essential basis of kosmos sounds like the linking + arranging I saw VALIS doing, + this 'seed' sounds like the rational VALIS invading the greater (boundless) irrational or non-kosmos."
uncertainty_flags: Olive Holt / King-Felix cipher: PKD presents two possible equations (CP + KGB = +3 vs. CP + US = -1) but cannot definitively determine which is correct; the meaning remains encrypted
Thomas identity: Unclear whether this is a discrete personality transferred into PKD, a divine aspect, a character from his fiction, or PKD's own higher self
Frederick the Elector Palatine: PKD claims this figure 'shows up' in MITHC but provides no textual evidence or explanation of how the encoding works

Nag Hammadi discovery date: PKD speculates 'in 1945 at Nag Hammadi' the 'Secret Living Blood of Christ' was unearthed, but historical Nag Hammadi findings (1945-1946) were Coptic Gnostic texts, not Christian relics; unclear if PKD is referencing actual history or visionary mythology
The nature of 'freighting': PKD claims the brotherhood can 'get into peoples' heads' and inject content; mechanism remains unspecified
Ormazd vs. Ahriman mapping: PKD explicitly maps Zoroastrian dualism to the binary computer but does not clarify whether Ahriman is Satan, the Demiurge, or the irrational universe itself

raw_text: in 2-3-74. I am ∴ one of their secret brotherhood. + damn glad of it: as they say, they are the red secret Xtian church, + totally hidden. Their great weapon is knowledge (enlightenment), which is what I got in 2-3-74, plus their supernatural powers. They share inner space + a common pool of esoteric knowledge - which they can transfer telepathically. I know it. In 3-74 I saw the Great Books + the Hermetic diagrams. They know the secret of 1) turning time into space; + - 2) they freight (or cook) our media with their messages. They are thus the secret power that rules this world (or hologram). 3) they can utilize synchonicity which is outside cause - + - effect + time. Specifically, they 1) know we have been invaded by an occluding organinism; + 2) their enlightenment counters it. I wonder how they link up to VALIS. Maybe VALIS is their GHQ, their cephalos. A) Olive Holt } B) Intelligence officer in the army} KGB! You have to link the two data together to get the answer. Like "King - Felix." One alone is not enough (i.e. "Olive Holt" could just mean CP, + B could be us or OCCP. But together they delineate KGB!). Originally there were 2 possible equations: [Diagram] 1) CP (+ 1) + KGB (+2) = +3 2) CP (+1) + US (-2) = -1 [/Diagram] I know believe it to be (1). The surface + the latent reinforce, rather than offsetting. This is why I was so confused: there is a vast difference, in this, between reinforcing (+3) + cancelling (-1). ---------- Wouldn't it be something if the RC were able to transfer an actual personality to - into - me? that Thomas hadn't been previously in me. The gnostic + other material in my writing (e.g. in "Tears") is their media freighting. There must be some way they can get into peoples' heads. The RC may comprise one collective Macromind. This would be the cosmic Christ or VALIS. The RC was behind Frederick, the Elector Palastine, which shows up in "MITHC"! I found a typed page starting: "VALIS' activity is a binary system of off-on. We see only the "on" of the off-on arrangements. We do not see them as arrangements but merely as change." More + more this binary computer model of VALIS seems to be the correct one. "On" is the linking of two parts which I saw: "on" equals junction; "off" equals disjunction or not inclusion in the vast assembly which I equate with VALIS. Put another way I saw high speed linking as the primary activity of VALIS. This was simply its "on" mode, so it must be everywhere, + what I construed as VALIS vs non-VALIS was "on" vs "off" of a binary computer. Then everything is the computer whether linked or not - whether the assembly (what I called "VALIS") or not. These are neural connections in a brain. "on" is "connect" + "off" is "disconnect," there is a evolution toward connection: toward a developing Macrothought in which everything is connected: worked in as relevant. Then there is something other than just a binary on-off computer. "on" more + more predominates over "off"; it seeks "on." its goal is "on" as a means to developing a total all-parts interaction. "off" could be regarded as a lack, a failure, a defeat, an impediment to be overcome. We still have a binary system, but priority (plus value) is given to "on." Then there are two orders of reality (set to ground?). The "on" or junction (which is higher or set), + "off" as disjunction (which is lower as ground): this might explain, then, the discrimination of set to ground which I achieved: on to off. Linked to unlinked, VALIS to not-VALIS - + even more ultimately, the ultra thought to the not-yet (part of) ultra-thought. What I call "VALIS," then is a thought, or rather the thought. This sheds a whole new light on 1) the set / ground which I saw. 2) what "Valis" is. (a forming thought.) One could say the "the rational invading the irrational" which I construe as going on is the deliberate, purposeful formation by a computer brain - using a binary system - of an ultimate thought which can be regarded as 1) activity or process; or 2) is a thing; the thought as network of interlinked "neurons" in a particular pattern (which has as one attibute that of absolute beauty, + perhaps should ultimately be so regarded). Yet to construe this "as the rational invading the irrational" is not only not far off as an appraisal but positively brilliant (although incomplete). The unlinked "neurons" equal disorder. The linked "neurons" equal order. My God - the causal train melting! The ultra-thought was (seen by me) forming between my very eyes. This is the override I saw, the modulation - the changes in reality including me. I was incorprated into the ultra-thought which I have termed "VALIS." The "St Elmo's Fire" - the vast knowledge all at once available to me - this is the ultra-thought all that "Hermetic" transtemporal gnosis is contents of the ultra-thought. Reality as knowledge. This "Hermetic" knowledge was physical reality which I could see + touch. Physical reality went through a transform + became knowledge. The thought could be said to have changed. It changed, + no one remembers that it had been formerly different; again, everything I experienced has to do with anamnesis. I remembered that things (the thought) had just an instant before been quite different. Anamnesis set in before the change set it. (2-74 compared with 3-74.) Did they want witnesses who would remember things as they had been - i.e. "Tears." But if "Tears" is a record of "how things had just previously been" (But no one remembered), "Tears" is Acts, so Acts had just a moment before been our world - which conforms exactly with my 2-74 anamnesis; that's what I remembered (real memories breaking through the false). Was this a good change? Yes - obviously; "Tears" is the BIP. The change was an enormous improvement; the removal of part of the curse itself (cf my Metz speech: orthogonal motion to a less-cursed world or alternate universe). I hadn't been living in "Tears"; we all had been. However, I remembered, but not until 2-74 + the Golden Fish sign. I did not know it in 1970 when I wrote the novel. A physical record of that alternate world was inserted into this world (or "track"), using me as an amanuensis. Then "Tears" is, as I intuited, scripture. The macro brain (computer) wanted the information stored (retained, encoded). It was concealed in a minor s-f novel, where it could excite no notice. This related to the dialectic 1) progression through the frames: + 2) "memory" derived from the current frame, in contrast to true memory of former, different frames - "Tears," then, is a crucial former different frame, + my memory of it (anamnesis) true memory. (The conjunction of the 2 frames was not in linear time - i.e 2000 years apart - but along a form axis in which the two were morphologically tangent; this is another of my major dicoveries.) I am building a terrific system here, with the binary computer, macro brain + ultra thought, + the frames through which we move (prior thought formations objectified giving rise to new belief systems, etc), reality - physical reality - as knowledge, + the form axes, the inner other universe of the immortals, the supermen who are trans-spacial + transtemporal dwelling in the inner universe + hence outside of clock time B, + who emerge into the exterior universe repeatedly (+ undetected by other people), + Ormazd vs Ahriman being the "on" + "off" of the binary computer, + the nature of true memory (anamnesis) vs current frame clue false "memory." Plus the possible misuse of the computer by someone, + its designer guiding us as a "low murmuring voice" against the misus by this irrational "operator" or demiurge," i.e. Satan who has taken control of "Creation" + the rational (thought) forming + growing + complexifying in the midst of the irrational (i.e. misuse of the computer): the antithetical strife between the rational (thought) + the irrational, with the former "cannibalizing" the latter to self-construct, until finally it is - has incorporated - everything. + the orthogonal leap from track A ("Tears") to track B (this reality) being a quantum growth - leap of the rational ultra thought or VALIS; + the dialectic of the Binary Computer inexorably driving everything along: the logical antinomies in sequence, + the possibility of seeing VALIS (the ultra thought) as set to ground, + its activity of self-construction. + "Salvation" consisting of being incorporated into it, + thus experiencing reality as information; absolute information which ultimately is beauty, not information at all: i.e a picture of the slain - dying - God: i.e. tragic. Xtianity is a cruel religion - yet accurate. It recognizes + conveys the true picture of this world: inglorious death, the beauty of which exceeds the weight, the burden, of the tribulation. Only when reality is experienced as the body (onto) of Christ , + its life process as the Sacred Blood, are we really home. What, oh what, if it were true that in 1945 at Nag Hammadi the actual Secret Living (information / Logos) Blood of Christ was unearthed, + through it, he was restored or the world (the "plasmate" which I describe in "Valis")? That Blood having recreated the Mystic Corpus Christi which (rational) is now growing within the old irrational universe? I just realize I've seen Christ in micro forms - as the death of the cockroach + rat + Pinky + in macro form: the universe flowing with his Blood. + what if he is Thomas + became (replaced) me, as well? ---------- All the knowledge revealed to me in 3-74 pre Newtonian. ---------- My 3-74 state was the resurrected state. So death (I had died) is an alchemical process of transmutation, like magic. It has this effect due to 1) it turning you into a christ; + 2) this is what took place with Christ, this alchemical transmutation, upon his death. Pythagoras had a strange cosmogonical belief: a seed (male) inserted into the boundless (female) which then progressively grows by incorporating more + more of the atelos (incomplete or unbounded into its carefully limited (telos) structure - a process "like inspiration with the boundless called 'breath.' " This view of careful limitation (boundaries) being the essential basis of kosmos sounds like the linking + arranging I saw VALIS doing, + this "seed" sounds like the rational VALIS invading the greater (boundless) irrational or non-kosmos.➀ Also the term "kosmos" is used by him to mean an ultimate beauty, more so than order. Pythagorianism was shamanistic, placed emphasis on health, on Apollo + the Delphic sibyl, on reincarnation, on revealed truths which gave you magic power over nature (reality), + form + number as the basis of reality, not substance. It (his system) was more a mystical religion having to do with the migrations of the soul than it was a philosophy. he strongly influenced Plato's metaphysics - certainly the platonist views about anamnesis. All this was related to Orphism. "Of things in human life, what displays most wisdom? Medicine." My revealed dialectic could be that of Empedocles. I'd say at this point that 3-74 was very Pythagorean. ➀ "Living cosmos. It grows by drawing in + assimulating the unlimited outside, that is by conforming it to limit + giving it numerical structure."
